title: dolicholus tomentosus
intro: Dolicholus tomentosus, commonly known as the 'Wild Sweetpea', is a perennial plant that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dolicholus tomentosus include its use in treating skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, and its ability to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The plant contains bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
